text:
Ava: Quick thread 11 Launch webinar next Tue. We need final copy, assets, and routing by EOD tomorrow.
Diego: Platform priority: X main thread, LinkedIn long post, short clip for Stories and short-form.
Priya: Agree. Also want 2 benchmark-led variants + 1 product narrative variant for A/B.
Zoe (creative): Can do hero image (16:9), 30s clip, 3-card LinkedIn carousel, and a 6s GIF. Need a tight brief.
Ava: Brief here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/launch_assets_live (please upload to /marketing/final).
Zoe (creative): Adding comps by 4pm. Will include mobile crops and captions baked in.
Ethan (ads): For paid amplification I need a 15s cut + still hero by tomorrow 11am with CTAs. Will handle UTMs.
Priya: Posting cadence proposal:
```
Tue 10:00 PT - X thread (hero + pin thread starter)
Tue 10:10 PT - X follow w/ clip + benchmark highlight
Tue 10:30 PT - LinkedIn long-form (narrative + signup link)
Tue 14:00 PT - Reminder story clip (short)
```
Ava: Nice. Zoe, please deliver 3 headline options per copy variant. One headline should be engagement-forward (question or trap).
Zoe (creative): Will do. Tagging @Priya for tone.
Priya: Tone: product-forward, clear CTA. Benchmark variant should hint at performance but avoid raw numbers on socials.
Diego: Lead routing: Noah will own inbound hot leads. SDR-bot: New rule request 1 if signup source contains "x_thread" AND company_size > 50 => tag as "hot" and route to #sdr-inbound + email noah@redwood.ai.
SDR-bot: action scheduled. Also recommend: if signup spike > 2x baseline in first hour, trigger SDR surge and notify #marketing.
Noah: I'll stand up a 2-person triage for first 3 hours after the webinar. Will prep a lead sheet and qualification checklist.
Ethan (ads): Proposed UTM: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=xlnk&utm_campaign=webinar_launch_q2_v2
Priya: Copy samples, quick sketches:
- Short (engagement): "Curious how teams cut inference cost? Join our product demo -> register"
- Benchmark (tease): "See how the runtime keeps latency steady under load. RSVP for the demo."
- Narrative: "We built an inference layer that makes LLMs predictable at scale. Join our walkthrough."
Ava: Swap out any direct cost claims; reserve exact numbers for the blog/bench page. Social should tease.
Priya: Got it. I'll drop finalized variants into the drive by 9am tomorrow.
Zoe (creative): Quick Q on color vibe 1 teal or plum for hero?
Diego: Teal for X, plum for LinkedIn. Keeps the feed contrast.
Ava: Timeline recap: assets in Drive by EOD tomorrow, copy variants in by 9am, ad-ready 15s by 11am. React :thumbsup: if you can meet.
Zoe (creative): :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Ethan (ads): :thumbsup:
Noah: :thumbsup:
Diego: Also let's plan a pinned follow thread with the highest-performing clip after 1 hour. Monitor impressions and CTR.
Ava: Who is on live watch?
Ethan (ads): I'll monitor paid and organic dashboards first hour. Priya 1 can you watch replies and capture top engagement?
Priya: Yup. I'll capture top 8 replies and flag any product or sales asks to #support and #sdr-inbound.
Ava: Engagement play: reply templates + DM template offering a 1:1 demo to top engagers. Priya + Noah to draft.
Noah: Drafting now. Will include qualification script and meeting booking links.
SDR-bot: Reminder set for 2024-07-08 09:00:00 PT for final sign-off.
Zoe (creative): Uploaded first comps: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/launch_assets_live - naming: hero_v1.png, clip_30_v1.mp4, clip_15_v1.mp4, carousel_v1_01.png..03.png
Diego: Thanks. Ethan 1 once Zoe confirms final filenames I'll add UTMs and schedule boost.
Ava: Final check 1 ensure captions look OK for mute playback (auto captions baked in for clip).
Zoe (creative): Will bake captions into 15s and 30s cuts.
Priya: Also prepping a short FAQ card to post in thread for fast support triage.
Ava: Great. Final huddle tomorrow 9am PT to sign off. Keep this thread updated with uploads.
Priya: On it.
Noah: Ready for triage doc, dropping template shortly.
Ethan (ads): Will set up monitoring dashboard and alert if CTR drops below expected baseline.
Ava: Thanks team 1 see you tomorrow.
